glossary.definition: 193 UNIT 4 Unit Outcomes At the end of this unit, you will be able to: ) explain rate of reaction ) describe the pre-conditions for a chemical reaction to occur ) discuss factors that affect rate of chemical reaction, and ) demonstrate scientific enquiry skills, including observing, predicting, comparing and contrasting, communicating, asking questions, drawing conclusions, applying concepts, relating cause and effect, making generalizations and problem solving
